ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Pluto

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on friends and plans for the future. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your career and your goals. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on relationships and partnerships. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on home and family. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your money and what you value. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on rest and your inner life. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.
